subject.title: feat(control-ui): import Codex and Claude Code memory

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose provider-neutral operator Gateway and Plugin SDK surfaces that discover local Codex and Claude Code memory metadata and copy selected files into agent workspaces?
rationale: Code review can assess correctness, but automation cannot decide whether private local-memory discovery and write authority belong in the long-term Control UI operator API and public plugin contract.

options.title: Approve bounded memory RPC
options.body: Accept the memory-only, selection-bound, fingerprinted, idempotent, backed-up operator surface and require exact-head validation before merge.

options.title: Keep migration CLI-only
options.body: Decline the new Gateway and native-client surface while retaining provider-owned CLI migration behavior and revisiting a narrower UI capability later.

options.title: Narrow the public contract
options.body: Keep the Control UI feature but make the migration seam internal or explicitly experimental until compatibility and security expectations are finalized.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded memory RPC
recommendation.body: Accept the memory-only, selection-bound, fingerprinted, idempotent, backed-up operator surface and require exact-head validation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature, linked product issue, migration architecture, and cross-surface integration are centered in their recent work, making them the strongest available decision owner.
